name: HeadsUp
description:
A keyboard-first heads-up display: focus timer, Caffeine, local services, commands and a chat with your own model, opened with Super+Space.

It stays active on the lock screen (unlock-dialog) only to keep timers, Caffeine and services running; nothing of it shows there. To use Super+Space it takes that key from GNOME's keyboard layout switch when you have one layout or agree in Preferences (Shift+Super+Space still switches layouts), and gives it back when turned off. Services and commands you add run as your own subprocesses, each service in its own systemd scope.
